description: Land Title Settlement Department - Penideniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320287
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
